about.title: About Me
about.content:
I’m a self-taught Frontend Developer who really enjoys building modern web experiences and constantly improving my skills. I got into programming at a young age, and since then I’ve learned mostly through documentation, personal projects, real-world experience, and a lot of trial and error.

I like turning ideas into fast, responsive, and user-friendly apps with a strong focus on clean design and good performance. Beyond coding, I care about teamwork, clear communication, adaptability, and always learning new things. I believe the best way to grow as a developer is to build real projects, take on challenges, and stay curious about new technologies.
